name: laxpud-vibekits
description: Laxpud's platform-neutral reusable skills for code comments, Python project standards, and documentation workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Reusable skills for comments, pyproject, and docs
interface.longDescription: A platform-neutral skill collection for code comment standards, Python pyproject.toml configuration, and project documentation workflows. The Codex adapter exposes the shared skills without adding platform-specific logic to the skill files.
defaultPrompt: Use code-comment-standard to review and improve comments in this codebase.
Use pyproject-standard when creating or editing pyproject.toml.
Use project-docs-bootstrap to organize README, TODO, docs, and project guidance.
